layout.task_threads_scope: How many tasks of each kind this server runs at once; the others wait in the queue. Changes apply to the queue at once.
layout.upload_task_threads_num_scope: Uploads sent as tasks, and generating transfer seeds.
layout.offline_download_task_threads_num_scope: Offline downloads fetching into the temporary folder.
layout.offline_download_transfer_task_threads_n: Offline downloads moving their finished files to the target storage.
layout.decompress_upload_task_threads_num_scope: Extracting archives: uploading the extracted files.
layout.speed_limits_scope: Each limit is shared by all the connections of its kind on this server, in KB/s. Empty means no limit.
layout.max_client_download_speed_scope: What clients download from this server: downloads, previews and playback through it, WebDAV and FTP reads.
layout.max_client_upload_speed_scope: What clients upload to this server: web uploads, WebDAV and FTP writes.
layout.max_server_download_speed_scope: What this server reads from storages when it relays a file (proxy, and the SMB, SFTP and FTP storages).
layout.max_server_upload_speed_scope: What this server writes to storages whose drivers honour it.
layout.multipart_uploads_scope: Web uploads sent in parts, one request each, which can resume after a broken connection.
layout.multipart_enabled_scope: Offers Multipart among the upload panel's methods.
layout.sync_bandwidth_scope: One limit for all sync jobs together, upload and download. It applies at once, also to running jobs, and is not saved: the server starts again without a limit.
layout.connections_scope: How many download connections a storage opens to one file at once. It belongs to each storage; change it in the storage.
layout.connections_none: No storage here limits its connections per file.
layout.elsewhere: {{count}} more are set on their own page:
layout.site_scope: The site's name and the announcement on its home page.
layout.lists_scope: How file lists page through long folders and keep their sort order.
layout.visibility_scope: Whether search engines may index the site and other OpenList servers may mount it.
layout.brand_scope: The logo, icons and colour of the site.
layout.page_layout_scope: How wide the pages are and how the settings are laid out.
layout.storage_details_scope: Whether the storages' used and free space is shown, and how.
layout.file_types_scope: Which file extensions open in which viewer.
layout.playback_scope: Autoplay and the audio cover; the types that are played through this server and the headers it leaves out.
layout.opening_scope: What a click on a file does first, on the site and on share pages, and how ZIP names are read.
layout.viewers_scope: Viewers on other sites that open a file by its link, and per-type preview choices.
layout.readme_scope: Whether a folder's README is shown, and whether its scripts are taken out.
layout.files_scope: What file lists hide, whether a selection downloads as one archive, and how file names are written to storages.
layout.links_scope: How the download links of files are signed, how long they last, and which query parameters go on to the storage.
layout.sign_in_scope: How users sign in, and how many devices each may keep signed in.
layout.sharing_scope: What visitors of share links may preview, whether shared files pass through this server, and how wrong share codes are held back.
layout.page_code_scope: HTML added to the head and the body of every page.
layout.global_other_scope: What the logs mask, the captcha reader some storages use, and what runs after files are written.
layout.seeds_scope: The trackers offered when a torrent seed is made. The other seed settings have a page of their own.

s3_restart_to_apply: Changes to the S3 server take effect after a restart.
s3_buckets_empty: Every bucket needs a name and a path.

about.tagline: A file list program that supports multiple storages
